title: As Brissett holdout lingers, Cardinals open OTAs

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: As Brissett holdout lingers, Cardinals open OTAs
sources.description: With new coach Mike LaFleur telling reporters that discussions are the "same as where we were a few weeks ago," the Arizona Cardinals opened up OTAs on Monday without veteran quarterback Jacoby Brissett, 33, who continued his holdout for a new contract.
